name: footmercato.net
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 16 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.footmercato.net scores 68 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Didomi was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (5 requests), and cookies __cf_bm on opti-digital.com.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 16 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /classement/, /joueur/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Continue without agreeing →" and reloading, Google Ads (15 requests), Google Analytics (1 request), Meta Pixel (1 request) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 10 elements on /, /live/, for example .group__main--desktopOnly.group__main > .articleFeatured > .articleFeatured__container > .articleFeatured__matches > .ma and .group__main--desktopOnly.group__main > .articleFeatured >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 333 ms
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
